         ALUMINA SILICATA

       Andalasite rock-Alumina 63, Silica 37 parts


Deep acting remedy for chronic complaints of brain, spine and nerves.
      Constriction is a marked general symptom, also constriction of orifices. Venous distention.
      Weakness, especially spinal. Aching and burning in spine. Formication, numbness, pain in all
      limbs. Epileptiform convulsion. Coldness during pains.



Head.--  Congestion of brain. Constriction of scalp. Pain in head,
      better heat, perspires. Pain in eyes, flickering. Frequent coryzas. Swelling and ulceration of
      nose.



Respiratory.--  Catarrh of chest, pain, raw feeling. Feeling of
      great weakness in chest. Stitching pains. Spasmodic cough with purulent viscid expectoration.



Extremities.--  Heaviness, jerking, numbness, aching and pains.



Skin.--  Formication along course of nerves, veins feel full and
      distended. Sore to touch and pressure.



Modalities.--    Worse  , cold
      air, after eating, standing.   Better  , warmth, fasting,
      resting in bed.



Dose.--  Higher potencies. -Lower triturations.
